Standort: Berlin

Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026

Arbeitszeit: Full time

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes
pay GmbH: career_mercedespay@mercedes-benz.com

GE Vernova is facing a momentum of hypergrowth, and we are currently scaling up our teams, creating others from scratch, and bringing our industry to the next level. Join us on this mission!

At GE Vernova Grid Solutions we are electrifying the world with advanced grid technologies. As leaders in the energy space our goal is to accelerate the transition for a more energy efficient grid to full fill the needs of tomorrow. With a focus on growth and sustainability GE Vernova Grid Solutions plays a pivotable role in integrating Renewables onto the grid to drive to carbon neutral.

You will lead Commissioning activities with an international team of Commissioning Engineers through different projects stages, starting from Commissioning Preparation through to on- site execution.

As a

HVDC Commissioning Manager (all genders)
you have a key position within key projects for the energy transition. You will report to the Regional Commissioning Team Leader.

The position requires international travels with construction site presence during the execution phase. The HVDC sites are located in Germany and Netherlands as well as in Singapore and Batam for the platform construction.

Why we come to work:

At GE Vernova, our employees are always up for the challenge - and we’re always driven to find the best solution. Our projects are unique and interesting, and you’ll need to bring a solution-focused, positive approach to each one to do your best. Surrounded by committed, loyal colleagues, if you can dare to bring your ingenuity and desire to make an impact, you’ll be exposed to game-changing, diverse projects that truly allow you to play your part in the energy transition.

Mission description

Ensure all testing and commissioning activities are planned and carried out in compliance with safety requirements, quality standards, and applicable regulations.
Build and develop the Commissioning Organization for projects within your scope, including preparation of Org- Charts & Mobilization Plans for Staff & Tools
Liaise with design office and PM team for timely issuance of data required for preparation of commissioning site works (specs, designs, BOQ, material lists, …)
Prepare the Commissioning Schedule in alignment with the consortium partner for the platform manufacturing
Prepare Commissioning documentation like ITPs & Checklists and setup a Completion Management System together with your Commissioning Team
Contribute with your Commissioning Team to Factory Acceptance Tests to ensure that systems delivered to site with the right quality
Maintain effective communication related to Commissioning scope with customers, contractors, and internal stakeholders and be the main point of contact
Collaborate with the Project Team about Quality, Claim & Risk Management

How You’ll Make an Impact

You will actively advance the Energy Transition by bringing our HVDC projects to a successful completion with our customers
You will support our Commissioning Department with your expertise and will develop yourself with the state-of-the-art technologies

Completed degree in electrical engineering, energy technology, or a comparable qualification.
Knowledge and several years of experience in Commissioning of substations, Power Plants or HVDC Systems.
Excellent Communication skills paired with strong Leadership skills in an internation project environment

jobs.occupation: Scientist - Oligonucleotide Synthesis Expert, Medicinal Chemistry (Chemiker/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Join us in shaping the future of drug discovery.
In this exciting role, you will actively drive the establishment and advancement of oligonucleotide-based drug discovery capabilities within Medicinal Chemistry, leveraging your expertise in oligonucleotide synthesis to create innovative therapeutic solutions. Our mission is to deliver high-quality, first-in-class drug candidates within competitive timelines while advancing new therapeutic concepts and modalities for targets of interest. Guided by a passion for excellence in drug design, synthesis, lead identification, and optimization, you will collaborate with world-class scientists and make a meaningful impact on the development of next-generation medicines.
Ready to make a difference? Apply now and help transform groundbreaking science into life-changing therapies.
Tasks & responsibilities

- In your new role, you will drive the technical execution of siRNA projects.
- You will execute solid-phase oligonucleotide synthesis at research to mid-scale using RNA synthesizers, applying both routine and next-generation phosphoramidite chemistries.
- Furthermore, you will plan, optimize and trouble-shoot methods to improve coupling, capping, deprotection, cleavage, yield, purity and scalability, and oligonucleotide conjugation chemistries.
- You will coordinate and perform purification, desalting and analytical characterization of oligonucleotides.
- Moreover, you will operate, maintain and troubleshoot critical laboratory instrumentation, and take accountability for the oligonucleotide synthesis facility.
- You will train and coordinate Laboratory Scientists, providing technical guidance and fostering knowledge sharing across the team.
- Finally, you will document results with a high level of accuracy and reproducibility, contribute to patent applications, and provide technical expertise as a hands-on point of contact for synthesis and purification questions in project teams.

Requirements

- Completed vocational training or Master's or Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline with extensive hands-on experience in oligonucleotide synthesis
- Strong practical expertise in solid-phase synthesis, deprotection, purification and analytical characterization of oligonucleotides including method development and optimization
- Sound knowledge of oligonucleotide conjugates, linker chemistry, and bioconjugation approaches
- Hands-on experience with laboratory instrumentation used in oligonucleotide synthesis and analysis; experience in setting up or managing an oligonucleotide laboratory is highly desirable
- Interest in innovative RNA therapeutics and modern drug discovery.
- Independent, structured and reliable working style.
- Collaborative and team-oriented mindset with excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- Fluency in written and spoken English, coupled with a willingness to acquire basic German language skills

Start date: ASAP
As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package. Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com
Recruitment process:
Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until September 7th,2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from beginning till mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews end of September
Please submit your application documents in English.

Job available in 2 locations: Remote, Erlangen

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

Discover Impactful Work

As a Sales Engineer Gauging within the Production Process & Analytics (PPA) business unit of the Chemical Analysis Division (CAD) at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will play a key role in driving commercial success across our Quality Control Systems portfolio.

You will be responsible for developing new business opportunities while growing existing customer relationships across assigned industrial markets and territory. Reporting to the Global Commercial Leader, you will execute strategic sales initiatives, identify opportunities for market expansion, and deliver value-driven solutions that help customers improve their manufacturing processes.

Your technical expertise, consultative selling approach, and ability to build lasting customer partnerships will be essential in achieving sales objectives and supporting the continued growth and profitability of the business.

A Day in the Life:

- Achieve assigned bookings, revenue and profitability targets.
- Develop and execute territory sales plans to identify and secure new business opportunities.
- Manage the complete sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through quotation, negotiation and closing.
- Identify AI-enabled solutions and digital services to support business growth and deliver measurable customer value.
- Maintain an accurate sales forecast and opportunity pipeline using Salesforce.com.
- Collaborate with partners and representatives to support commercial growth.
- Provide valuable market intelligence by monitoring market trends, competitive activities and customer-specific requirements.
- Develop trusted relationships with existing and prospective customers.
- Analyze customer production processes and recommend technical solutions that improve quality, productivity and operational efficiency.
- Engage customers with AI-enabled discussions and commercial solutions.
- Deliver outstanding customer experience through responsiveness, technical expertise and solution-oriented support.
- Demonstrate and present the technical capabilities and business value of Thermo Fisher Scientific’s Quality Control Systems.
- Collaborate closely with application specialists, service engineers, software experts and product management to develop customer-specific solutions.
- Maintain a high level of product, application, industry and AI knowledge to effectively position our solutions.
- Travel throughout the assigned territory and internationally as required, with approximately 50% overnight travel.

What to expect:

- Drive sales growth by achieving commercial targets across the assigned territory.
- Identify and develop new business opportunities while expanding existing customer relationships.
- Lead complex technical sales engagements from prospecting through contract negotiation and closing.
- Deliver consultative, value-based sales solutions tailored to customer manufacturing processes.
- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.
- Utilize Salesforce.com to manage opportunities, forecasting and customer engagement.
- Monitor market trends and competitive activities to support strategic business growth.
- Represent Thermo Fisher Scientific through regular customer visits and extensive travel.

Keys to Success:

Education

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, or another relevant technical discipline, or equivalent technical experience.

Experience

- Minimum of 3 years of successful technical sales experience in capital equipment, industrial instrumentation, process analytics or industrial automation.
- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal
- Packaging & Converting
- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.
- Strong organizational and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently.
- Experience using CRM systems (Salesforce.com preferred) together with digital sales and collaboration tools.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken).
- Additional language skills are an advantage.
- Valid driver's license and willingness to travel extensively.

Benefits:

We offer competitive remuneration, annual incentive plan bonus, healthcare, and a range of employee benefits. Thermo Fisher Scientific offers employment with an innovative, forward-thinking organization, and outstanding career and development prospects. We offer an exciting company culture that stands for integrity, intensity, involvement, and innovation!

Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Watch as our colleagues explain 5 reasons to work with us. As one team of 100,000+ colleagues, we share a common set of values - Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement - working together to accelerate research, solve complex scientific challenges, drive technological innovation and support patients in need.

#StartYourStory at Thermo Fisher Scientific, where diverse experiences, backgrounds and perspectives are valued.

Apply today! http://jobs.thermofisher.com (http://jobs.thermofisher.com)

Your Career at OMS PrüfserviceElectrical safety inspections are at the core of what we do at OMS Prüfservice. As an Electrician at our Berlin location, you will provide excellent service to our customers by ensuring the electrical safety and quality of inspections on site. With your work, you help create a safe working environment while becoming part of an innovative and future-oriented company.

About OMS Prüfservice
Our goal is to be the quality leader in electrical safety inspections. The foundation of our success is our strong team.

Working at OMS means thinking ahead and taking responsibility. By delivering excellent results, we build trust with our customers every day.

Our values guide everything we do. They shape our daily work and define our company culture. We have the courage to use our strengths and are committed to creating a safer and more sustainable future.

Perform electrical safety inspections at customer sites to ensure the safe operation of portable electrical equipment

Identify and record electrical hazards or defects using our digital inspection software and smartphone (for example insulation resistance, protective conductor resistance, or visible damage)

Create digital inspection reports and fault reports directly in the inspection software. Reports are automatically provided to the customer

You are a qualified electrician or have a comparable electrical qualification
You work carefully and pay attention to detail

You enjoy working with customers and have a friendly, professional attitude

English: C2 level (excellent written and spoken English)

German: B1 level (basic German skills)

Salary based on your experience
Holiday and Christmas bonus payments

Performance bonus of up to €100 per month

Permanent employment contract in a growing industry
30 days of annual leave
Company pension scheme and private accident insurance
Financial support for private cars (electric and combustion engine vehicles) and (e-)bikes

Childcare allowance
Modern working environment and Kununu Top Company award

Membership with EGYM Wellpass, giving you access to more than 10,000 fitness studios and online fitness courses

Various employee shopping discounts

Fixed working hours with no shift work

Start your working day directly from home

Paid travel time

Regional customer assignments
High-quality work clothing
A motivated team with flat hierarchies

Opportunity to take part in paid language courses

The Director, Sales Operations — DACH is a senior leadership role responsible for the operational effectiveness, productivity, and go-to-market efficiency of Mitel's sales organization across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland. The role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution, partnering directly with DACH Sales Leadership to drive performance through world-class processes, data-driven insight, and operational rigor.

Reporting to the Group Director, Sales Operations International, the Director will lead a dedicated DACH Sales Operations team and work in close partnership with cross-functional stakeholders across Finance, HR, Marketing, IT, and the global Revenue Operations function. This is a high-visibility role with direct impact on revenue, growth, and organizational effectiveness across one of Mitel's most strategically important regions.

Job Responsibilities

1. Sales Planning, Forecasting & Quota Management

- Lead sales forecasting, planning, and budgeting processes across the DACH region, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and strategic alignment with global Revenue Operations standards
- Design and own the equitable allocation of sales quotas across all DACH channels and resources, ensuring every team member is set up to succeed and all objectives are assigned on time
- Proactively monitor planning quality and process consistency; coordinate planning activities with Finance, HR, and global Sales Operations as required
- Attend and actively contribute to ELT forecast reviews, bi-weekly regional forecast reviews, and Close the Gap sessions, providing data-driven analysis and actionable recommendations
- Responsible for theatre communications within the DACH sales organisation on process, programmes, and initiatives

2. Go-to-Market Coverage & Territory Optimisation

- Design and optimise go-to-market coverage models across the DACH region, ensuring the right sales resources are deployed against the highest-value market opportunities
- Lead account segmentation initiatives — analysing firmographic, revenue, and growth-potential data to classify accounts and align them to the most effective sales motions
- Own sales representative and channel assignment frameworks, balancing workload, market potential, and specialisation to maximise revenue per head and overall regional ROI
- Partner with Sales Leadership and Finance to model territory design scenarios, simulate revenue impact, and make data-driven recommendations on coverage changes
- Continuously monitor coverage efficiency metrics including whitespace analysis, account penetration rates, and capacity utilisation to identify and act on growth opportunities

3. Channel Integrity & Direct/Partner Segregation

- Define, document, and enforce clear rules of engagement between Mitel's direct sales force and channel partners, ensuring unambiguous account ownership and minimising conflict across DACH
- Own and maintain the account segmentation framework that determines which accounts are served direct versus through channel, based on criteria including account size, strategic value, geography, and partner capability
- Establish and govern escalation and arbitration processes for channel conflict, acting as the neutral arbiter when direct and partner routes overlap or compete for the same opportunity
- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Proactively identify and eliminate bottlenecks in the sales process, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and operational rigour across DACH
- Lead process definition and documentation for DACH Sales Operations, including approval policies, PreSales workflows, and Service processes — developing Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) and ensuring cross-functional alignment
- Facilitate cross-departmental workshops to define, align, and continuously improve Sales Operations processes in collaboration with Finance, Legal, HR, and IT
- Working with Sales Leaders and Marketing, implement internal sales SPIFFs and Partner Rewards programmes, managing the delivery tools
- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed
- Build and maintain a suite of dashboards and reports that give DACH Sales Leadership the intelligence needed to make fast, well-informed decisions
- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Provide input to senior leadership in the development and administration of sales incentive compensation programmes for the DACH region
- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised
- Partner with the Service organisation on sales campaign coordination and deliver ad-hoc CRM-based sales reports to support Service planning activities
- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

Qualifications & Experience

- Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution, or equivalent professional experience (5+ years in B2B sales, sales operations, or sales management)
- Proven track record leading analytically complex Sales Operations or Revenue Operations initiatives with demonstrable business impact
- Deep expertise in CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred), sales analytics, and operational tooling
- Strong experience in quota design, territory modelling, and go-to-market coverage optimisation
- Experience managing or overseeing formal bid and deal approval processes in an enterprise B2B environment
- Demonstrated ability to manage channel partner relationships and enforce rules of engagement in a direct/indirect sales model
- Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to influence and present confidently at all organisational levels
- Deep understanding of the DACH business landscape, commercial culture, and regulatory environment
- Fluency in German and English (written and spoken) — additional language skills in French or Italian are a plus
